versions.content: function RegisterDataUpdateIndication [SWS_PER_00578] Upstream: RS_PER_00013 , RS_AP_00120 , RS_AP_00121 , RS_AP_00127 , RS_AP_00135 , RS_AP_00137 , RS_AP_00159 void RegisterDataUpdateIndication ( std::function < void(const ara::core::InstanceSpecifier &updatedStorage, ara::core::StringView updatedElement)> dataUpdateIndication, ara::core::InstanceSpecifier monitoredStorage, ara::core::Vector < ara::core::String > monitored Elements) noexcept; Registers a data update indication callback with Persistency. The provided callback function will be called by Persistency when an update of stored data happened. It will be called from the context of ara::per::UpdatePersistency , ara:: per::OpenKeyValueStorage, or ara::per::OpenFileStorage .
